name: Bakery display
summary: A slow slide along your counter, with warm light on the bakes.
outcome: A slow slide along your counter or display case, with warm light on the bakes.
photoGuidance: A photo of your display or counter, from the customer's side.
Fill the frame with the bakes.
limitations: Text and logos in your photo may change in the video. Check the result before you post it.

inputs.label: Details to keep as they are
inputs.help: Optional. For example, the colour of your cups or the shape of a sign.

inputs.label: Anything to leave out
inputs.help: Optional. For example, no smoke or no people.

prompt.preserve: Keep everything in the photo recognisable: the same objects, shapes, colours and proportions. Keep any printed text, labels and logos as they are.
prompt.avoid: Do not add people, hands, text, captions, logos or new objects. No sudden cuts, no camera shake, no warping or melting of surfaces.
prompt.subject: The photo shows {subject} in a bakery display.
prompt.composition: Keep the display as the main subject, framed as in the photo.
prompt.environment: The counter and shop stay as in the photo.
prompt.camera: The camera slides slowly and smoothly along the display.
prompt.lighting: Warm display light with soft reflections on the glass.
prompt.preserveExtra: Every bake keeps its shape, colour and position.
